_comment: Purchasable/usable items. Effect kinds: 'restrain_hit' caps a single hit's damage against a wild creature at cap_ratio * its max HP, for the rest of the current battle -- it does not stop a creature from being finished off over several hits, only from being ended in one. 'heal' restores percent% of the active creature's max HP. See docs/DESIGN.md sections 13 and 19.

items.name: Tempering Draught
items.description: Steadies the hand. For the rest of this fight, no single blow you land can end it outright.

items.name: Knitbone Salve
items.description: Comfrey root and tallow, packed cold. Closes what it can reach.
